items.title: Reconcile the trusted RED-to-GREEN enforcement execution plan
items.context: Update the existing v7 program plan against current 0.3.294 code and the trusted RED-evidence decision spec. Define current-vs-target truth, mechanical tri-class classification, trusted RED and exact-target GREEN contracts, lifecycle doors, legacy adoption, concurrency, adversarial evidence, rollout order, acceptance tests, and explicit non-goals. The document must remain a program plan and must not claim runtime enforcement already exists.
items.userSees: One current, implementation-sequenced Markdown truth source that states exactly which Stories require RED-to-GREEN evidence, how documentation-only work is exempted, and what evidence proves enforcement.
excludes: Creating RED or GREEN runtime evidence commands
Treating the plan as implemented authority

happy.desc: The plan defines a complete ordered program from trusted RED production through same-target GREEN consumption and enforcement rollout.

edge.desc: Pure refactor and mechanically proven non-executable documentation, research, and audit Stories have explicit non-synthetic evidence paths while retaining the normal lifecycle.

adversarial.desc: The plan closes declaration-only exemption, post-hoc RED, v1 self-report, rollback-door, direct-terminal compatibility, stale receipt, chain fork, and concurrent transition bypasses.

items.title: Freeze and independently audit the candidate plan with Claude CLI
items.context: Audit the exact candidate bytes in read-only Claude CLI mode. Record tool version, timestamp, candidate digest, invocation rubric, raw response digest, findings, truth-source adjudication, accepted changes, rejected suggestions, and final verdict in a separate audit Markdown file. If the first verdict has blockers, revise the plan and repeat until APPROVE or report the unresolved blocker.
items.userSees: A reproducible Claude CLI audit record bound to the exact final plan bytes, with no audit prose represented as runtime or lifecycle authority.
excludes: Allowing Claude CLI to modify repository files
Treating an APPROVE response as implementation evidence
Auditing mutable or unhashed plan bytes

happy.desc: The final audit records Claude CLI version, exact plan SHA-256, exact rubric, response SHA-256, and an APPROVE verdict for those bytes.

edge.desc: Any unavailable, timed-out, or non-APPROVE audit remains explicitly blocked and cannot be described as approval.

adversarial.desc: The audit record distinguishes external reviewer opinion from signed Proof-or-Stop lifecycle evidence and runtime truth.
